effect.shortEffect: Embody Aspect boosts a particular stat, depending on the form of a Terastallized Ogerpon
effect.full: Embody Aspect boosts a particular stat, depending on the form of a Terastallized Ogerpon

french.sv: Le Pokémon fait briller le Masque en puisant dans ses souvenirs, ce qui augmente ses stats.

english.ttm: The Pokémon's heart fills with memories, causing the Mask to shine and one of the Pokémon's stats to be boosted.

japanese.ttm: 思い出を 心に 宿すことで おめんを かがやかせ 自分の 能力を 上げる。
